# Nekkos

> Open-source, local-first AI chat, cowork, and coding in one calm window. Nekkos' headline feature is **first-class local model support**: point it at Ollama, LM Studio, or vLLM in one click, alongside every major cloud provider. Desktop, self-hosted web, and Docker editions run the same engine and the same UI. MIT licensed, by Nekko Labs.

Local model UIs are essentially a chat box around a model with no awareness of your files or projects. Terminal agents are powerful but blind. Nekkos sits in between: an IDE-like surface where the agent reads, edits, searches, and runs inside your actual codebases, with every action visible through a context-provenance inspector and approval prompts.

## Key facts

- **What it is**: a local-first AI coding and cowork app (Electron + React) that unifies conversation and coding into one surface.
- **Local models first**: one-click setup for Ollama, LM Studio, and vLLM, plus every major cloud provider. Verified end-to-end against a live LM Studio server, including reasoning models and the full multi-step tool-calling agent loop.
- **Editions** (same engine, same UI, different transport): **Desktop** (macOS, Windows, Linux) available; **self-hosted web** (`npx nekkos` or `npm run web`, fully offline) available; **Docker** (`docker compose up`, workspaces as volumes) available; **phone remote control** (pair by QR, end-to-end encrypted, managed relay free in beta or self-host it) available; **Nekkos Cloud** (paid, hosted, always-on Zero-Data-Retention mode, cloud history and files) planned.
- **Privacy**: local-first. Inference and tools stay on your machine, data lives in `~/.nekkos`. Nekkos Cloud's relay is an end-to-end-encrypted pipe to your own paired agent, so driving a local model from your phone stays private by design.
- **Licence**: MIT, open source, developed in the open with contributions welcome.

## Features

Nekkos' second pitch, after local models, is **the harness**: the scaffolding around the model that decides how well a model you run yourself performs on real work. It splits into what the model sees, what it can reach, and what happens when it gets something wrong.

**Unified chat / cowork / code** in one window, no mode switching.

What it sees:

- **Context Inspector**: every file, guideline, memory entry, and index snippet entering the next prompt, with per-source token counts, a window-headroom bar, and a toggle or pin on each. The unsent draft is counted as you type it.
- **Grounded retrieval**: a multi-folder index (file tree, code outline, search) so a large repo arrives as the relevant slice instead of a wall of text.
- **Guidelines and memory**: `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` plus a markdown memory store, global and per project, each entry individually switchable.
- **A living spec**: build `SPEC.md` (plus a plan and task list) from the conversation and feed it back as context.
- **Prompt analyzer**: offline, zero-latency analysis of your draft with an A to F score and click-to-fill suggestions.

What it can reach:

- **Sub-agents and swarms**: scoped subtasks run in fresh child sessions with their own context, under a solo / balanced / swarm strategy with depth limits.
- **Skills**: real procedures (research, plan, review, security-review, test, commit, PR) with visualized workflows, plus a marketplace.
- **MCP in both directions**: connect stdio or streamable-HTTP MCP servers, including [Hypergate](https://hypergate.app) as a gateway, and run Nekkos itself as an MCP server.
- **Connectors**: Linear, Slack, Discord, Gmail, and Drive, folded into context as snippets.
- **Goal loops that terminate**: plan first, re-inject the plan each iteration, bounded context window, turn and time budgets, and stall detection.

When it's wrong:

- **Guardrails by default**: a risky-command classifier behind an editable allow / ask / deny policy; Ask, Guardrails, or YOLO per chat.
- **Sandbox out of the box**: file access jailed to your folders, with optional Docker isolation for shell commands.
- **Diff review**: agent edits land in a Changes panel as a line diff, keep or revert at line, file, or all.
- **Recovery**: an empty reply is retried with a nudge and then surfaced, and "Reset here" rewinds the chat to any earlier message.

- **Nekkos**, a hand-drawn astronaut cat that works in zero-g while the model thinks.

## Install

Grab the installer for your OS from the [latest release](https://github.com/nekko-labs/nekkos/releases/latest): Windows `.msi`/`.exe`, macOS `.dmg`, Linux `.AppImage`/`.deb`. macOS builds are not notarized yet, so clear the quarantine flag once with `xattr -cr "/Applications/Nekkos.app"` after installing.
